verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a table-to-HTML enrichment that uses agentic AI or a VLM to produce an HTML representation of each detected table, so the core of the story exists. However, nothing in the evidence shows how faithfully it handles complex structures such as merged cells, nested headers, or tables spanning multiple pages. Missing for 10: documented handling of merged cells/rowspan-colspan, nested multi-level headers, multi-page table stitching, markdown table output, and independent or hands-on fidelity corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, complex tables — merged cells, nested headers, multi-page spans — come out as faithful HTML/markdown structure

citations.quote: After partitioning, you can have Unstructured generate representations of each detected table in HTML markup format. This table-to-HTML output is generated by using agentic AI or a vision language model (VLM).
Create a job to partition and enrich local files into AI-ready JSON with image descriptions, table HTML, named entities, and generative OCR output.
